about: Editing scenarios typed into the real CodeMirror editor (apps/web/src/EditingScenarios.stories.tsx) in Chromium and in WebKit, the engine of the Mac app's WKWebView editor. `caret` is an index or {"after": text}; `select` selects the first occurrence of a text. `keys` is typed character by character; {return} {tab} {backtab} {backspace} {left} {right} {up} {down} {home} {end} {cmd-return} {alt-up} {alt-down} {cmd-b} {cmd-i} {cmd-l} {cmd-shift-x} are keys and {paste:TEXT} pastes TEXT. `expect` is the Markdown and `caretAfter` the text just before the final caret.

scenarios.name: type a whole code block, closing fence included
scenarios.expect:
# T
```swift
let a = 1
let b = 2
```
後の段落

scenarios.name: return after an opening fence closes the block
tilde fences and an unclosed block at the end
an already closed fence gets a plain newline
list syntax inside code stays literal
lists continue, indent, outdent and end
numbered lists continue and end
todos from [] and command-return
command-return checks a todo without moving the caret
command-return keeps a bullet and adds the checkbox
[] after a bullet and full-width brackets
return at the start of item text adds an empty item above
home stops after the checkbox, backspace removes the marker
backspace after a bullet removes the bullet
headings typed character by character
scenarios.keys: タイトル{return}## 節{return}本文 **太字** と `code`
scenarios.expect:
# タイトル
## 節
本文 **太字** と `code`

scenarios.name: a heading appears when its space is typed
return inside a heading splits it
typing over a selection that spans markers and lines
tab inside code inserts a tab at the caret
tab in a paragraph inserts a tab at the caret
tab and shift-tab indent and outdent a todo from anywhere in it
quotes continue and an empty quote line ends them
scenarios.expect:
# T
> 引用
> 続き
後

scenarios.name: return in the middle of item text splits the item
backspace on an empty item removes it, a second joins the lines
return at the start of heading text inserts a line above it
the Japanese IME's 「」 also creates a todo, but not around text
a new code block above a paragraph and another block stays separate
a new code block between two blocks stays separate
typing * over a selection wraps it, twice makes bold
typing ~ over a selection makes strikethrough
typing [ over a selection makes a link and puts the caret in its URL
typing * over a selection in code replaces it
pasting a URL over selected text makes a link
scenarios.doc:

公式サイト を見る
scenarios.expect:
# T
[公式サイト](https://example.com/docs) を見る

scenarios.name: pasting plain text over a selection replaces it
return in the middle of an ordered list renumbers the rest
option-up and option-down move the current line
option-down moves a selection of lines
quotes hide their marker; backspace after it removes it
command-return on a numbered todo toggles it
command-b and command-i wrap the selection
command-i makes italics (not CodeMirror's select-parent)
command-shift-x makes strikethrough
command-l inserts a link and selects its URL
